definitions.gloss: change (formal); small change returned to a customer
definitions.explanation: The money given back to a customer when they pay more than the amount owed. A formal alternative to the everyday {お{釣|つ}り}, commonly seen on receipts, signs, and in business contexts.

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
「{釣|つ}り{銭|せん}のないようにお{願|ねが}いします」と{書|か}いてあった。
examples.english: It said, 'Please pay the exact amount (no change required).'

examples.japanese: {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}が{故障|こしょう}して、{釣|つ}り{銭|せん}が{出|で}てこなかった。
examples.english: The vending machine broke down and didn't give back any change.

notes:
Compound of {釣|つ}り (from {釣|つ}る, originally a verb of pulling) + {銭|せん} (small money). The everyday spoken word for the same thing is お{釣|つ}り; {釣|つ}り{銭|せん} appears more on signs, receipts, and in formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}を{渡|わた}す: to hand over the change
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}を{切|き}らす: to run out of change
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}のないように: please pay the exact amount
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}{機|き}: change machine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{釣|つ}り: change (everyday/spoken)
- {小銭|こぜに}: small change; coins (the coins themselves, not specifically money returned)
